title: 第一卷 第378章 宁天你给我等着第一卷 第377章 父亲我还有一招
slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 唐三没有回应宁天。
相反，刚才被打得七荤八素、险些丧命的唐三，此刻出奇地安静了下来。
应该说，令人意外的是，虽然他身上那对折断的黑翼和粗壮的蝎尾还在，暗魔邪神虎的邪气也没有散去，但他脸上的癫狂却退去了大半。
那只猩红的左眼和漆黑的右眼里，重新浮现出了人类该有的清明。
唐昊看着唐三的变化，有些迟疑地唤了一声。
唐三摇了摇脑袋，随后转过身，走到唐昊身边，凑近唐昊的耳畔，压低声音，快速说了几句什么。
两人距离很近，声音压得极低，再加上峡谷里风声呼啸，哪怕是古榕和千道流这种级别的强者，也没能听清。
宁天看着这父子俩嘀嘀咕咕的模样，打了个哈欠。
“我说你们俩，商量遗言呢？”
宁天伸手指了指半空中的千道流。
“这老头脾气可不太好。”
“有什么话赶紧交代，过了这村可就没这店了。”
千道流确实没什么耐心。
看着唐三那副不人不鬼的模样，他内心的厌恶感已经升到了极点。
“妖邪之物，死有余辜。”
千道流冷哼一声。
他手中的天使圣剑再次举起，九十九级绝世斗罗的魂力全面爆发，刺目的金光照亮了整个峡谷。
就在千道流准备一剑将这对父子彻底净化的时候，唐昊动了。
听完唐三的话，唐昊脸上的表情在短短一秒钟内疯狂变换。
震惊、犹豫、不甘，最后定格在一种破釜沉舟的决绝上。
唐昊身上的魂力毫无保留地爆发开来。
不过，出乎所有人意料的是，他并没有像刚才那样试图引爆身上剩下的黑色魂环。
取而代之的，是唐昊直接开启了武魂真身。
一柄巨大无比的昊天锤虚影在峡谷中凝聚成型，带着排山倒海的气势，被唐昊双手死死握住。
“宁天！
拿命来！”
唐昊咆哮出声，双腿猛地发力。
地面直接被踩出一个巨大的深坑，唐昊整个人借着这股反冲力，如同出膛的炮弹一般，举着巨大化的昊天锤，越过半空中的千道流，直奔宁天砸了过去。
面对这雷霆万钧的一锤，宁天站在原地，连躲都没躲。
他不仅没躲，甚至还歪了歪脑袋，脸上露出了一个极其荒谬的表情。
这就完了？
刚才唐三吼得那么大声，说什么“还有一招”
结果搞了半天，所谓的底牌，就是唐昊不开炸环，直接拿个武魂真身过来砸人？
宁天转头看了一眼古榕。
“古爷爷，唐家这爷俩脑子确实不太好使。”
古榕也是一脸错愕。
他甚至连武魂都没放出来，只是双手抱胸，看傻子一样看着扑过来的唐昊。
“天儿，这唐昊怕是想儿子想疯了。”
content_en:
Tang San didn't respond to Ning Tian.
On the contrary, Tang San, who had been beaten to a pulp and almost died, was surprisingly quiet at this moment.
It should be said that what is surprising is that although the pair of broken black wings and thick scorpion tail on his body are still there, and the evil aura of the Dark Demon Evil God Tiger has not dissipated, most of the madness on his face has receded.
In that scarlet left eye and pitch-black right eye, the clarity that humans should have reappeared.
"Mistress..."
Tang Hao looked at Tang San's changes and called out with some hesitation.
Tang San shook his head, then turned around, walked to Tang Hao's side, leaned close to Tang Hao's ear, lowered his voice, and said a few words quickly.
The distance between the two was very close, and their voices were extremely low. Coupled with the howling wind in the canyon, even strong men like Gu Rong and Qian Daoliu couldn't hear them clearly.
Ning Tian looked at the murmuring expressions of the father and son and yawned.
"I asked you two to discuss your last words?"
Ning Tian stretched out his hand and pointed at Qian Daoliu in mid-air.
"This old man has a bad temper."
"If you have anything to say, tell me quickly. There is no store like this after passing this village."
Qian Daoliu really has no patience.
Seeing Tang San's inhuman appearance, the disgust in his heart had risen to the extreme.
"Evil things deserve to die."
Qian Daoliu snorted coldly.
The angel holy sword in his hand was raised again, and the soul power of the ninety-ninth-level peerless Douluo exploded, and the dazzling golden light illuminated the entire canyon.
Just when Qian Daoliu was about to completely purify the father and son with one sword, Tang Hao made a move.
After listening to Tang San's words, the expression on Tang Hao's face changed crazily in just one second.
Shocked, hesitant, unwilling, and finally settled on a desperate decision.
"Boom!"
The soul power in Tang Hao exploded without reservation.
However, to everyone's surprise, he did not try to detonate the remaining black soul ring like he did just now.
Instead, Tang Hao directly activated the martial soul's true form.
An incomparably huge phantom of the Clear Sky Hammer condensed and formed in the canyon, carrying an overwhelming momentum, and was tightly held by Tang Hao's hands.
"Ning Tian!
Take your life! "
Tang Hao roared and exerted force on his legs.
A huge deep pit was directly trampled on the ground. Tang Hao used this recoil, like a cannonball, to hold up the huge Clear Sky Hammer, cross the thousand streams in mid-air, and go straight to Ning Tian to smash it.
Facing this thundering blow, Ning Tian stood on the spot, not even trying to hide.
Not only did he not hide, he even tilted his head, showing an extremely ridiculous expression on his face.
Is this the end?
Just now Tang San roared so loudly, saying "there's one more move"
After working on it for a long time, the so-called trump card was that Tang Hao didn't use the explosive ring, but just used the martial spirit avatar to hit people?
Ning Tian turned around and glanced at Gu Rong.
"Grandpa Gu, the two men of the Tang family are really not very smart."
Gu Rong also looked stunned.
He didn't even release his martial spirit, he just crossed his arms and looked at Tang Hao who was rushing towards him like a fool.
"Tian'er, this Tang Hao is probably going crazy because he misses his son."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 378 Ning Tian, ​​just wait for me Volume 1 Chapter 377 Father, I have one more trick
